verdict.rationale: vLLM is designed to run as a local inference engine on the user's own hardware (GPUs/CPUs/Apple Silicon etc.), supporting local HuggingFace models via pip/uv install or Docker, with no requirement to send data to external servers, and an OpenAI-compatible API served locally. missing for 10: explicit privacy/data-never-leaves-device statement, independent hands-on confirmation of fully offline/air-gapped operation.
